name: Bahrain

elections.note: 40 single-member seats, two-round system. Exact date to be confirmed.

leaders: King Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa; Crown Prince and Prime Minister Salman bin Hamad
summary: Bahrain elects the lower house of parliament; the upper house is appointed by the King. Candidates run mostly as independents, and the main opposition societies were dissolved in 2016–2017 and remain barred.
noParties: Candidates stand largely as independents. Major opposition political societies (Al-Wefaq, Wa'ad) are banned from running.
